name: Fujiwara Itsurin Mitsuaki
original_name: 藤原 一輪 光秋
source:
"Don't sulk. You know I love you."

An eccentric woman who shares history with both Akane and Igarasu. She watches passively from afar as their conflict proceeds toward its inevitable conclusion.

[From [url=http://www.jastusa.com/hanachirasu.html]JAST USA[/url]]
